name: Funny Burlap Nurse Wine Bag with Drawstring
seoTitle: Funny Nurse Wine Gift Bag for Graduation
metaDescription: A funny burlap drawstring wine bag for nurses, an easy way to wrap a bottle for an LPN graduation, Nurses Week, or a thank you to a nurse who earned it.
summary: A funny burlap nurse wine bag turns a bottle into a ready made gift for an LPN graduation, Nurses Week, or a thank you after a long stretch of shifts.
whyItWorks: A bottle of wine after finishing nursing school, or after a brutal week on the floor, is a classic for a reason. The bag is what makes it feel like a nurse gift rather than a grocery run. A funny nursing message on burlap gives it a rustic, handmade look and gets a laugh before the drawstring is even pulled open.

It solves the wrapping problem too, since wine bottles are awkward to wrap and a drawstring bag takes seconds. That makes it handy for a busy family member putting together an LPN graduation gift or a manager handing out bottles for Nurses Week. Since the title notes it is personalized, you may be able to add a name, which helps it work as a keepsake. If wine is not their thing, the bag can hold sparkling cider, a fancy coffee, or a small bundle of treats. Many nurses end up reusing these for gifts of their own.
goodToKnow: The bag does not include wine; you supply the bottle.
Check the listing for what personalization is available and how to submit it.
For a nurse who does not drink, fill it with sparkling juice or snacks instead.

faq.q: Is this a good LPN graduation gift?
faq.a: Yes, especially with a bottle of their favorite wine inside. It is festive, a bit funny, and easy to hand over at a party.

faq.q: Can this go to a coworker at the hospital?
faq.a: Check your workplace rules about alcohol on site first. Many people hand it over after work or fill it with a non alcoholic treat.
